variants.label: Cboe PutWrite index (PUT) — measured: sell an at-the-money put on the S&P 500 every month, the cash in Treasury bills
Cboe BuyWrite index (BXM) — measured: hold the S&P 500 and sell an at-the-money call on it every month
Cboe 2% out-of-the-money BuyWrite index (BXY) — measured: hold the S&P 500 and sell a call 2% above it every month
